messages.msg: Q04 introduces the ternary operator on strings ({isLive ? 'Live now' : 'Recorded'}, Terms row New with a refresher) as the fix for an if inside braces, and teaches that numbers show (0 shows 0) while true, false, null, and undefined show nothing. Map 10 can recall the ternary from Q04 and build the && pitfall on those two facts; the example component is ArticleCard with isLive.
messages.resolution: Map 10 recalls the ternary and the values that print from Q04 (Prerequisite rows; Terms rows ternary operator and true, false, and null as Recall) and builds and-not-number on them; the example is ArticleCard with isNew and a New label instead of isLive (plain setting, brief 2026-10-15-07).
